The '''Lo'Uran system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Aparo sector/Legends|Aparo sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lo'Uran]].
